{{Quote|Velery Station, this is Gray Flight, escorting private yacht Night Caller.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
'''Gray Flight''' was the designation adopted by [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]{{'s}} complement of four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. Pretending to be the crew of ''Night Caller'', which was part of [[Zsinj|Warlord Zsinj's]] forces, some [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] performed many operations under the disguise of Gray Flight. Most notable was their participation in the [[Battle of Talasea]] and [[Battle of Ession|Ession]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />
